# moeSegFault Style v0.2.0

- Source: <https://github.com/kleedaisuki/moesegfault-style/tree/9080365/static-releases/v0.2.0>
- Canonical distribution: <https://style.moesegfault.dev/v0.2.0/>
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later; Geist and Geist Mono are OFL-1.1 (license texts sit beside the fonts).

Every file is an unmodified copy of the release artifact, verified against the SHA-256 values in the release
`manifest.json`. To upgrade, add a sibling directory for the new version and repoint the imports in
`src/styles/global.css`; never edit these files in place.

The package is not on a registry yet and its Git source ships no build output, so a pinned copy is the only
reproducible way to consume it without a runtime dependency on another origin.
